relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved elder brother; her helplessness during his near-death motivates her to learn true healing.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Mentor and physician who agrees to teach her after treating her hidden injuries.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Close friend who sees her resolve and parts with her for separate summer plans.

periods.summary: Shizuku attends Ikki's victory party, scolds Ikki and Stella for nearly killing each other in the final, and quietly accepts that their bond is genuine. Remembering how useless she felt when Ikki nearly died after fighting Amane, she travels to Hiroshima to ask Kiriko Yakushi to teach her healing. Kiriko reveals that Shizuku's own vaporization technique has left dangerous bodily distortions and insists on treatment first. Shizuku refuses anesthesia so she can experience Kiriko's healing technique directly, enduring extreme pain out of resolve to be able to save Ikki next time.

key_events.summary: Scolds Ikki and Stella and decides to pursue medical training.
Accepts treatment and begins the path to learn Kiriko's healing arts.
